# BIP39 English data

`english.txt` is copied unchanged from bitcoin/bips commit
`86d96b63b063c40eafd5db65fff5aa118e6def59`, path `bip-0039/english.txt`.
SHA-256: `2f5eed53a4727b4bf8880d8f3f199efc90e58503646d9ff8eff3a2ed3b24dbda`.
`english.inc` mechanically represents the same 2048 sorted words as explicit
length and eight-byte storage entries. No executable third-party code is used.

The BIP identifies its license as MIT. The reference implementation's MIT
license is retained from trezor/python-mnemonic commit
`b57a5ad77a981e743f4167ab2f7927a55c1e82a8`. The corresponding published test
vectors use no real wallet; only those public fixture values enter tests.
